tools.name: myapi_status
tools.description: Check the MyApi ASC connection status. ALWAYS call this first before myapi_request. On first run it generates an Ed25519 keypair and outputs the public key for registration. Once the key is registered and approved this confirms the connection is live.

tools.name: myapi_request
tools.description: Make any authenticated request to the MyApi API. This is the single gateway to all MyApi features: identity, preferences, connected services, service proxy (Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Slack, and 30+ more), skills, notifications, workspaces, devices, export, and anything added in the future. All requests are signed with the ASC Ed25519 key — no bearer token needed. Refer to the MyApi API docs at https://www.myapiai.com/docs for available endpoints.

path.description: API path, starting with /. Do NOT include /api/v1 — it is added automatically. Examples: "/identity", "/connectors", "/services/linkedin/proxy", "/skills", "/export".

query.description: Query string parameters as a key/value object.
